visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontally scrolling category navigation (icon + label links)
visualCharacteristics.description: White background, 48px padding. Red small eyebrow 'Vrei să vezi ceva fresh?', centered H2. Horizontal category slider (14 round icons + labels, first active in red). 3-col grid of grey product cards with red 'NOU' badge, title, short text, 'VEZI DETALII' link and product image on red curved shape. Centered outlined CTA 'Vezi toate produsele'.

contentPattern.structure: one row per category; cell 1 = icon image only; cell 2 = label linked to the category page
contentPattern.description: Repeating structure of 14 icon + label items (category navigation). Source buttons filter the product grid client-side; represented as authorable cards linking to category menu pages.

usage: Menu category bar above the product grid. The item whose link matches the current page gets aria-current="page".
reuseGuidance: Use for compact icon + label link rows that may overflow horizontally; scroll arrows appear only when the list overflows.
